chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ays ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the visitation after the visitation of Hajj during the days of Tashreeq, so he said: 'No'.

key_terms.أَيَّام التَّشْرِيق: Days of Tashreeq (11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)
key_terms.زِيَارَة الْحَجّ: The visitation associated with the Hajj pilgrimage
key_terms.لَا: No (indicating negation or rejection of the act)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing a separate Kaaba visitation after Hajj during the days of Tashreeq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a separate, distinct Ziyarah is not prescribed during the days of Tashreeq, as the Tawaf performed as an integral pillar of Hajj suffices for the ritual visitation. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that the Hajj Tawaf fulfills the obligation of visiting the House, rendering a redundant, separate visitation unnecessary during these specific days of rest and sacrifice. It highlights the precision in distinguishing between obligatory acts of Hajj and recommended supererogatory visits in Shia fiqh.
